entities.summary: Tranbjerg J is a town in Aarhus in Denmark. "J" is for Jutland to distinguish this place from a similarly named place on Zealand, and is not used in daily parlance. Tranbjerg is a quarter in Northern Europe. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
